Description

### Spectral White Edition - Purity in Performance

For enthusiasts who crave a pristine and elegant look without compromising on performance, the Spectral White Edition of the RX 7800 XT Hellhound is the epitome of design excellence. Unlike other brands that merely switch the cooler's color, PowerColor has gone the extra mile. The Spectral White Edition boasts an all-white PCB, a first-of-its-kind all-white heatsink, and a white cooler, setting a new benchmark in graphics card design.

### It's not just about aesthetics

Beneath its sleek exterior lies the same raw power and performance that the Hellhound series is renowned for. With state-of-the-art cooling, lightning-fast clock speeds, and a unique LED lighting system with three modes - blue, white, and off, controlled via a physical switch - this edition promises to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.

1. Metal Reinforced Backplate

2. Dual BIOS

3. High Quality 14-Layer PCB Design

4. DrMOS with IMON Digital Monitoring

5. Ice Blue and Glacier White LED Color

6. Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement

7. Ring-fan Blade Design

### High Quality Japanese Dual Ball Bearings

Dual ball bearings reduce rotational friction, providing excellent heat dissipation and effectively doubling the expected lifetime of the fans.

## Intelligent Fan Controller

Utilizing temperature detection from a smart chip, fans will start running when the GPU reaches 60℃ and shut down below 50℃. Efficient cooling, fan-noise reduction, and extended product lifetime are all benefits of a more accurate temperature monitoring.

### Unprecedented Ring-fan Blade Design

The newest 9-blade design of our fans generates better airflow and air pressure under the same noise level, improving cooling performance to reduce GPU temperatures by more than 3℃ compared to previous generations.

### GPU Direct-Contact Copper Plate

We have increased the copper plate area to provide direct contact with the GPU while covering VRAM to increase the heat transfer threshold to the max.

### Vertical Fin Heatsink

A brand new white heatsink with closely spaced vertical fins is mounted on the PCB, offering a larger heat-spreading area and improved heat radiation. This allows airflow to efficiently disperse heat.

### Turbulence Reducing Fan Rotation

The middle fan spins in the reverse direction to reduce the air turbulence, which reduces noise level without sacrificing the cooling efficiency.

### Optimum Heatpipe Arrangement

A set of 5 x 6φ fresh new white nickel-plated copper heatpipes align closely above the PCB to more quickly and effectively transfer heat from the GPU and VRAM to the cooling array.

### Car-Grade Power Module DrMOS with iMON Real Time Digital Monitoring

Hellhound adopts a 9+2+1 phase VRM design with DrMOS to power the GPU as well as an additional 2+1 phase specifically designated for the VRAM. New IMON technology monitors and reports the electric current and power consumption on each individual phase. By balancing the workload, the Hellhound ensures unparalleled stability and thermal protection during overclocking.

### High Quality PCB Design

A premium 14-layer high TG PCB Board -including a 2 oz power layer- is utilized in the Hellhound RX 7800 XT; a PCB such designed decreases signal loss during transmission: important especially for high power currents, with added stability.

### Metal Reinforced Backplate

The metal backplate strengthens and protects the internal components from PCB bend, and a cut-out design on the back plate allows exhaust heat to properly flow through for heat-dissipation efficiency.

### Ice Blue and Glacier White LED Color

Hellhound of this generation now comes with two LED color options. Gamers are able to choose the color they want by flipping the switch on side of the card. Ice blue shows the Hellhound's coolness, while glacial white projects a crisp, calm, elegance.

### Dual BIOS Mode

Hellhound RX 7800 XT features Dual BIOS built-in and a switch for easy swapping. -OC BIOS: A boosted mode that increases fan RPM to keep your card operating at a lower temperature to drive higher performance. -Silent BIOS: Focused on lower noise and fan longevity, a milder fan speed, trading fan speed and noise for moderate, but still controlled, temperatures while maintaining performance.

Radeon™ Anti-Lag

Radeon™ Boost

AMD RDNA™ 3 Architecture with Hardware Raytracing

Introducing AMD Radeon™ RX 6500 XT graphics cards, featuring the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture and engineered to deliver great gaming performance with remarkable efficiency. Blaze a trail into tomorrow, dive into 1080P gaming, enjoy vivid virtual worlds, and elevated experiences with the power of next-generation graphics.

The PowerColor Radeon™ RX 6500 XT Fighter graphics card is armed with a dual 80mm cooling fan design, it is cool and quiet, ideal for anyone looking to game without distractions.
